response.sql: WITH dated AS (SELECT type, amount, CASE WHEN length(CAST(date AS TEXT)) = 6 THEN '19' || substr(CAST(date AS TEXT), 1, 2) || '-' || substr(CAST(date AS TEXT), 3, 2) || '-' || substr(CAST(date AS TEXT), 5, 2) ELSE substr(CAST(date AS TEXT), 1, 10) END AS transaction_date FROM trans) SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) FROM dated WHERE transaction_date > '1996-05-09' AND transaction_date < '1998-01-06' AND type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ');

assumptions.assumption: Transaction dates are stored as either YYMMDD or ISO-formatted dates; the supplied context does not specify their format.
